pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about BB Crème, from choosing a shade to daily wear.

faqs.question: Which BB Crème shade should I choose: Fair, Light, Light/Medium or Tan?
faqs.answer: Fair suits the lightest complexions, Light is for fair-to-light skin, Light/Medium is for light-to-medium skin with a little more warmth, and Tan is for medium to deeper tones. Because BB Crème is a lightweight blur with low-to-medium coverage, it blends toward your natural tone, so if you sit between two shades choose the lighter one for everyday wear. Still unsure? Email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo and the shades you wear in other brands and we will help you pick before you order.

faqs.question: How much coverage does BB Crème give?
faqs.answer: BB Crème gives low-to-medium coverage with a soft, semi-matte finish designed to blur and even out mature skin rather than mask it. Your skin still looks like skin, with redness and small discolorations softened. For extra help on age spots or under-eye darkness, layer a Nikol Beauty color corrector or Creamy Concealer only where you need it instead of adding more BB Crème.

faqs.question: Is BB Crème suitable for dry or combination skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is enriched with shea butter and emollient oils, plus Kakadu Plum, one of the richest natural sources of Vitamin C, so it stays comfortable and hydrating throughout the day. If your skin is very dry, apply your moisturizer first and let it absorb for a few minutes before applying BB Crème.

faqs.question: Do I need a moisturizer or primer underneath?
faqs.answer: Start with your usual skincare and give it a few minutes to set. A primer is optional: our Fiercely Smooth Face Primer smooths texture and helps BB Crème last longer, but BB Crème also works beautifully on its own over moisturizer.

faqs.question: Will BB Crème settle into fine lines?
faqs.answer: Use a small amount and build in thin layers, pressing it in with the Foundation Buffing Brush or your fingertips rather than dragging. Let your skincare and primer absorb first, then set only the areas that need it, such as around the nose and mouth, with a light dusting of Nikita Banana Brightening Powder. Less product means less to settle into lines.

faqs.question: Nothing is coming out of the pump on my new bottle. What should I do?
faqs.answer: BB Crème uses an airless pump, and the product can lose contact with the pump if air gets trapped during shipping. Shake the bottle well, turn it so the pump faces downward, and pump gently several times until the product begins to flow. If it still will not dispense, email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a photo of the bottle and the batch number embossed near the base, and our Customer Care team will make it right.

faqs.question: Can I build it up over redness and age spots?
faqs.answer: You can add a second thin layer where needed, but for stronger correction pair it with a color corrector applied underneath: No Redness for redness, or Just Peachy and Simply Apricot for darkness. Then apply BB Crème over the top for an even, natural finish.

faqs.question: How long does one bottle last?
faqs.answer: A little goes a long way, so with daily use most customers find a bottle lasts for months. Store it upright at room temperature, away from heat and direct sunlight, to keep the formula fresh.

faqs.question: How is BB Crème different from the Serum Foundation?
faqs.answer: BB Crème is a lightweight complexion blur with a semi-matte finish and low-to-medium coverage, ideal for an effortless everyday look. Serum Foundation is a skincare-infused liquid with a radiant, silk-smooth finish and buildable light-to-medium coverage, applied with a dropper. Choose BB Crème for a quick, natural finish and Serum Foundation when you want more luminosity.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Serum Foundation, from choosing a shade to daily wear.

faqs.question: Which Serum Foundation shade should I choose, and which are cool or warm?
faqs.answer: Serum Foundation comes in four shades: Ivory and Fair have cool undertones, while Light and Light-Medium have warm undertones. If your veins look blue or pink and silver jewelry flatters you, start with Ivory or Fair; if your skin leans golden or peachy and gold jewelry suits you, look at Light or Light-Medium. For a personal recommendation, email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo and the foundation shades you already wear.

faqs.question: How much coverage does the Serum Foundation give?
faqs.answer: It gives customizable light-to-medium coverage with an ultra-natural, radiant, silk-smooth finish. Skin looks more even-toned and imperfections are diffused rather than masked. Start with a few drops and add a second thin layer only where you want more coverage.

faqs.question: Do I need the Fiercely Smooth Face Primer underneath?
faqs.answer: A primer is optional. Serum Foundation applies beautifully over well-absorbed skincare on its own, but if you have visible pores or texture, or you want extra wear time, a thin layer of Fiercely Smooth Face Primer creates a smoother canvas. Whichever you choose, let it set for a few minutes before applying foundation.

faqs.question: Why do I need to shake the bottle before each use?
faqs.answer: Serum Foundation is a skincare-infused liquid, and its pigments and serum ingredients can settle between uses. A good shake blends them back together so the shade and coverage stay consistent from the first drop to the last.

faqs.question: How do I use the dropper without applying too much?
faqs.answer: Shake well, then dispense two or three drops onto the back of your hand rather than directly onto your face. Pick the product up with the Foundation Buffing Brush, a damp sponge or your fingertips and press it into the skin in thin layers. A little goes a long way, and you can always add more where needed.

faqs.question: How do I keep it from settling into pores and fine lines?
faqs.answer: Let your sunscreen and moisturizer absorb fully, about five to ten minutes, before applying, since layering over a still-dewy base is the most common cause of settling. Apply a thin layer with gentle pressing motions instead of sweeping or rubbing, and finish crease-prone areas such as under the eyes and around the mouth with a light touch of Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: Is it fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Serum Foundation is fragrance-free and made without parabens or sulfates, and the formula is designed to be gentle for all skin types. It also contains Salicylic Acid, which helps improve the look of your skin over time. As with any new product, patch test first if your skin is very reactive.

faqs.question: Should I choose Serum Foundation or BB Crème for everyday wear?
faqs.answer: Choose BB Crème if you want a quick, lightweight blur with a semi-matte finish and low-to-medium coverage. Choose Serum Foundation if you prefer a luminous, radiant finish with buildable light-to-medium coverage and skincare benefits. Many customers keep both: BB Crème for easy days and Serum Foundation for a more polished look.

faqs.question: What if the shade I ordered is not right for me?
faqs.answer: Because our products are personal-care items, all sales are final and we are unable to accept returns or exchanges once an order has shipped. We are always happy to help you choose before you buy, so email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo and we will recommend a shade. If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and your invoice and we will make it right.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Creamy Concealer, from choosing a shade to a crease-free finish.

faqs.question: Does the Creamy Concealer come as a set, or do I choose one shade?
faqs.answer: Each Creamy Concealer is sold individually, and you choose one of three shades: Fair (CC01, cool), Light (CC02, cool neutral) or Med (CC03, warm). Many customers own two so they can conceal with one shade and use a lighter shade to highlight, or mix in a warmer shade for summer.

faqs.question: Which shade should I order: Fair, Light or Med?
faqs.answer: For under-eye concealing, choose the shade closest to your skin tone or a touch lighter. Fair is cool-toned for the lightest complexions, Light is a cool neutral that suits most fair-to-light skin, and Med is warm for light-medium to medium tones. Nikol wears Light to conceal, uses Fair to highlight and mixes in Med for a warmer summer concealer. Email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a photo if you would like a recommendation.

faqs.question: Will it settle into the fine lines under my eyes?
faqs.answer: The formula was created for mature skin, with a creamy, moisturizing texture that gives high coverage without weight. To keep it crease-free, apply a small amount, blend with the Concealer Brush or your ring finger using gentle pressing motions, and set lightly with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder using the Soft Set Technique Brush.

faqs.question: Does it go over or under a color corrector like Just Peachy?
faqs.answer: Color corrector goes on first, directly on the discoloration, and Creamy Concealer goes over the top. The corrector neutralizes the darkness so you need far less concealer for a bright, natural finish.

faqs.question: Do I need to set it with the Nikita Banana powder?
faqs.answer: Setting is optional but recommended if you want the longest wear or your skin is oily. A light press of Nikita Banana Brightening Powder keeps the concealer from creasing and settling into fine lines while brightening the under-eye area.

faqs.question: How much coverage does it give on dark circles?
faqs.answer: Creamy Concealer is a high-coverage liquid concealer with a luminous finish. For deep or blue-toned dark circles, pair it with Just Peachy or Simply Apricot color corrector underneath so a thin layer of concealer is all you need.

faqs.question: Which brush works best for applying it?
faqs.answer: Our Concealer Brush has uniquely sculpted bristles and a dense tip made for precise, buildable application under the eyes. You can also use the Nikol Beauty Concealer/Lip Brush or your fingertips; just press and blend rather than dragging the delicate under-eye skin.

faqs.question: Is it gentle enough for thin, sensitive under-eye skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Creamy Concealer is fragrance-free and enriched with soothing Chamomile Flower Water, Evodia Rutaecarpa Fruit Extract, Allantoin and Sodium Hyaluronate to help calm and hydrate the delicate eye area. It is clean beauty, cruelty-free and made in Italy.

faqs.question: What if the shade I ordered is not right for me?
faqs.answer: Because our products are personal-care items, all sales are final and we cannot accept returns or exchanges once an order has shipped. We are glad to help you choose beforehand, so email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo for a recommendation. If an item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and your invoice and we will take care of it.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Eye Brightener and where it fits in your routine.

faqs.question: Where does the Eye Brightener go: over or under my concealer?
faqs.answer: Apply Eye Brightener as a finishing step over your concealer, or on its own on lighter-makeup days. Its pink-based creamy formula neutralizes dullness and brings light to the under-eye area, so a small amount patted over concealer gives that awake, illuminated look.

faqs.question: Can I use it on my eyelids as well as under my eyes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A thin layer on the lid or inner corner brightens the whole eye area. For eyeshadow that stays put all day, use our Eye Primer on the lid and reserve the Eye Brightener for under the eyes and the inner corners.

faqs.question: What does it do that a concealer or color corrector does not?
faqs.answer: A color corrector cancels discoloration and a concealer covers it; the Eye Brightener adds light. Its pink base illuminates and lifts the under-eye area, and it is lightweight, oil-free and enriched with Chamomile Flower Water and Sodium Hyaluronate, so it also helps the skin look smoother and more hydrated.

faqs.question: How much should I use?
faqs.answer: Very little. Dot a small amount under each eye and pat it in with your ring finger or the Concealer Brush. The tube is 1.5 ml because only a tiny amount is needed each day, so it lasts longer than it looks.

faqs.question: Will it crease under my eyes during the day?
faqs.answer: Applied sparingly over set concealer it should stay smooth. If you are prone to creasing, press a light touch of Nikita Banana Brightening Powder over it with the Soft Set Technique Brush.

faqs.question: What should I do if product collects around the applicator?
faqs.answer: Wipe the applicator and the neck of the tube with a clean tissue after each use and close it tightly. If your Eye Brightener arrived leaking or damaged, email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a photo and your invoice and our Customer Care team will make it right.

faqs.question: Do I need to set it with powder?
faqs.answer: Setting is optional. On normal to dry skin many customers wear it without powder for a dewy finish. If your skin is oily or you want maximum wear, set lightly with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: Is the single shade meant to work on every skin tone?
faqs.answer: Eye Brightener is a sheer, pink-based illuminator rather than a concealer, so it is designed to blend into a wide range of skin tones. On deeper complexions apply an even thinner layer over your concealer and blend the edges well.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eye Brightener is fragrance-free, oil-free and free of parabens and phthalates, with calming Chamomile Flower Water for sensitive, delicate skin. It is cruelty-free and made in Italy.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Nikita Banana Brightening Powder and how to set without heaviness.

faqs.question: Is Nikita Banana tinted, and will it work on deeper skin tones?
faqs.answer: Nikita Banana is a soft yellow pressed powder that is universally flattering. The yellow tone brightens and neutralizes darkness rather than leaving a white cast, so it blends into fair, medium and deeper complexions alike when applied with a light hand.

faqs.question: Where do I apply it: only under the eyes, or all over my face?
faqs.answer: Both work. Use the Soft Set Technique Brush to press it gently under the eyes to set concealer, or dust it over the whole face or just the T-zone with the Essential Powder Brush to absorb oil and soften the look of pores. Apply it after concealer and foundation as your finishing step.

faqs.question: How do I keep it from looking cakey or settling into lines?
faqs.answer: Use less than you think you need. Tap the excess off your brush, press the powder into the skin rather than sweeping it back and forth, and set only the areas that need it. Nikita Banana is designed to keep concealer from creasing, so a light touch is all it takes.

faqs.question: Which brush should I use with it?
faqs.answer: For the under-eye area, press the angled side of the Soft Set Technique Brush into the powder and gently press it into place. For all-over or T-zone setting, use the Essential Powder Brush from our brush set. Use a sponge or puff only where you want fuller coverage.

faqs.question: Does it set concealer and corrector, or replace them?
faqs.answer: It sets them. Apply your color corrector and Creamy Concealer first, then press Nikita Banana over the top to lock everything in place and brighten. It can also be worn alone over the BB Crème or Serum Foundation for a soft veil of coverage.

faqs.question: Will it make my pores look larger?
faqs.answer: No. Nikita Banana absorbs oil and diminishes the appearance of pores for a smooth, soft finish. Apply a thin layer with a pressing motion rather than dragging so the powder sits on top of the skin instead of gathering in pores.

faqs.question: Is this a translucent powder or a brightening powder?
faqs.answer: It is a brightening powder. Unlike a colorless translucent powder, its soft yellow tone corrects redness and dark under-eye circles while it sets your makeup, so you get setting and brightening in one step.

faqs.question: Can I use it over the BB Crème and the Serum Foundation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nikita Banana is meant to be applied after your concealer and foundation, and it pairs beautifully with both BB Crème and Serum Foundation. Dust it lightly wherever you want less shine and longer wear.

faqs.question: Is it talc-free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nikita Banana Brightening Powder is talc-free and cruelty-free, and it now comes in a pink compact. Keep the compact closed and dry between uses to protect the pressed powder.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Fiercely Smooth Face Primer, from the airless pump to a smooth base.

faqs.question: What is the Fiercely Smooth Face Primer made with?
faqs.answer: Our new, improved formula is 95 percent of natural origin and completely silicone-free, so it does not feel like traditional silicone primers. It is a velvety, lightweight formula that absorbs quickly, minimizes the look of fine lines and preps the skin so your BB Crème or foundation applies more smoothly and lasts longer.

faqs.question: What do I do if the pump will not dispense?
faqs.answer: Fiercely Smooth uses an airless pump, and the product can lose contact with the pump if air is trapped during shipping. Shake the bottle well, turn it so the pump faces downward, and pump gently several times until the primer starts to flow. If it still will not dispense, email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a photo of the bottle and the batch number embossed near the base and our Customer Care team will make it right.

faqs.question: How much should I use?
faqs.answer: A pea-sized amount is enough for the whole face. Warm it between your fingertips and press a thin, even layer onto the areas where you want smoothing, such as the cheeks, forehead and around the nose. Using more than a thin layer does not add benefit and can affect how your foundation sits.

faqs.question: Do I apply it to bare skin, or over my serum and moisturizer?
faqs.answer: Apply it as the last step of your skincare, after your serum, moisturizer and sunscreen have fully absorbed, and before foundation. Cleansed, moisturized skin gives the primer the best surface to grip.

faqs.question: Is it hydrating, or is it for smoothing texture and controlling shine?
faqs.answer: Fiercely Smooth is designed to smooth and blur. It creates a soft, velvety canvas that fills the look of fine lines and pores, gives a radiant finish and helps makeup last, and it is suitable for all skin types and tones. Keep your moisturizer in your routine for hydration and let the primer do the smoothing.

faqs.question: Do I still need it under the Serum Foundation?
faqs.answer: It is optional. Serum Foundation applies well on its own over well-absorbed skincare, but if you have visible texture or want extra wear time, a thin layer of Fiercely Smooth underneath gives a smoother, longer-lasting result.

faqs.question: How long should I wait before applying foundation over it?
faqs.answer: Give it a minute or two to settle into the skin. The formula absorbs quickly, and once it feels velvety rather than tacky you are ready to apply your BB Crème or foundation.

faqs.question: Will it keep my makeup out of fine lines and pores?
faqs.answer: That is exactly what it is for. Fiercely Smooth blurs the look of fine lines and pores and gives your BB Crème a smoother surface to sit on, so makeup is less likely to settle and lasts longer through the day.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Fiercely Smooth is clean beauty, silicone-free and 95 percent of natural origin, and it is formulated for all skin types and tones. If your skin is very reactive, patch test on a small area first, as you would with any new product.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Just Peachy, from who it suits to how to layer it.

faqs.question: Which skin tones is Just Peachy formulated for?
faqs.answer: Just Peachy is a peach-based corrector designed to disguise dark circles and dark spots on fair to light-medium skin tones. If your skin is light-medium to medium, or your discoloration leans blue or purple, Simply Apricot is usually the better match.

faqs.question: How much should I apply?
faqs.answer: A little goes a long way. Apply a thin swipe directly onto the darkest part of the under-eye or the spot you want to neutralize, then blend the edges with your fingertip or the Concealer Brush. Build a second thin layer only if the darkness still shows through.

faqs.question: Where does it go in my routine?
faqs.answer: Apply your moisturizer and sunscreen and let them absorb, then apply Just Peachy to the discoloration. Follow with Creamy Concealer over the top and your BB Crème or foundation, and finish by setting the under-eye area with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: Will it settle into the creases under my eyes?
faqs.answer: Just Peachy has a creamy, lightweight texture with shea butter that is made for mature skin. Keep the layer thin, press rather than rub, and set lightly with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder to keep it smooth through the day.

faqs.question: Do I need to put concealer over the top of it?
faqs.answer: Yes. A color corrector neutralizes the darkness but is not meant to be worn alone. A thin layer of Creamy Concealer over Just Peachy evens the tone and gives you a bright, natural finish with far less product than concealer alone.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Just Peachy and Simply Apricot?
faqs.answer: Both cancel darkness, but Just Peachy is a lighter peach for fair to light-medium skin, while Simply Apricot is a deeper apricot for light-medium to medium skin and stronger blue or purple discoloration. If you are between the two, Just Peachy is the softer option for everyday brightening.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Just Peachy is clean beauty, fragrance-free and cruelty-free, with a moisturizing shea butter formula that is gentle on the delicate under-eye area.

faqs.question: How do I care for the product so it lasts?
faqs.answer: Twist up only a small amount at a time, apply with light pressure and retract it before replacing the cap. Store it at room temperature away from heat, and wipe the tip with a tissue occasionally to keep it clean.

faqs.question: Where can I see how to apply it?
faqs.answer: Nikol demonstrates Just Peachy step by step on her YouTube channel, youtube.com/nikoljohnson, including how to place it, blend it and layer concealer over it for a bright under-eye. If you have a question about your specific concern, email hello@nikolbeauty.com and we will point you to the right tutorial.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about No Redness, from blending the green to all-day wear.

faqs.question: It looks green on my face. How do I blend it out properly?
faqs.answer: The minty green tone is what neutralizes redness, and it disappears once it is blended and covered. Apply it only to the red areas, blend the edges with your fingertips or the Concealer Brush, then apply your BB Crème or foundation over the top. The green should never show through the finished look.

faqs.question: How much do I need to neutralize rosacea or general redness?
faqs.answer: Start with a thin layer directly on the red area and blend. No Redness gives medium to full coverage, so one thin layer is usually enough; add a second only where redness still shows. Using less and layering gives a more natural result than one heavy application.

faqs.question: What goes over it: BB Crème, foundation or concealer?
faqs.answer: Apply your moisturizer first, then No Redness on the red areas, then your BB Crème or Serum Foundation over the whole face. Use Creamy Concealer only where you want extra coverage, and finish by setting with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for rosacea-prone and sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. No Redness was created for exactly this: rosacea, T-zone redness and random flushing. It is clean beauty, fragrance-free and cruelty-free with a creamy, moisturizing shea butter formula that feels comfortable on reactive skin.

faqs.question: How do I apply it without dragging my skin?
faqs.answer: Warm the tip against the back of your hand for a moment, then swipe lightly or dot it onto the area. Blend with a patting motion using your fingertips or the Concealer Brush rather than pulling the product across the skin.

faqs.question: Can I use it on blemishes and broken capillaries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dot a small amount directly on the blemish or capillary, blend the edges and cover with your BB Crème or foundation. It also neutralizes hyperpigmentation with a red tone.

faqs.question: Will the coverage hold all day?
faqs.answer: Applied in a thin layer under your BB Crème or foundation and set with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder, No Redness stays put through a normal day. If you are very warm or active, a light touch-up of powder in the afternoon is all most customers need.

faqs.question: Does it work across all skin tones?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because the green cancels red rather than adding color, No Redness is ideal for all skin tones. Simply match your BB Crème or foundation shade over the top as usual.

faqs.question: Do I use it alongside Just Peachy, or instead of it?
faqs.answer: They do different jobs, so many customers use both. No Redness cancels red tones on the cheeks, nose and chin, while Just Peachy or Simply Apricot cancels blue and purple darkness under the eyes. Apply each only where it is needed, then cover with BB Crème or foundation.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Simply Apricot, from who it suits to how to layer it.

faqs.question: Who is Simply Apricot for, compared with Just Peachy?
faqs.answer: Simply Apricot is a deeper apricot corrector made for light-medium to medium skin tones and for stronger blue or purple discoloration under the eyes. Just Peachy is a lighter peach for fair to light-medium skin. If you have light skin with pronounced blue-toned circles, Simply Apricot can still work; it depends on your level of pigmentation.

faqs.question: Why does it look so orange in the stick?
faqs.answer: The warm apricot tone is what cancels blue and purple. It looks bold in the stick, but once a thin layer is blended and covered with Creamy Concealer the orange disappears and the under-eye simply looks brighter and more even.

faqs.question: What kind of discoloration does it cancel?
faqs.answer: Simply Apricot neutralizes blue and purple-toned imperfections, most often dark circles under the eyes and shadowy areas around the nose or mouth. For redness, use No Redness Color Corrector instead.

faqs.question: How much should I use under my eyes?
faqs.answer: Very little. Use the pointed tip to swipe a thin line directly on the darkest area, then blend with your fingertips or the Concealer Brush. The formula is buildable, so add a second thin layer only if darkness still shows.

faqs.question: Do I need concealer over the top?
faqs.answer: Yes. A corrector cancels the discoloration but is not meant to be worn alone. Follow with a thin layer of Creamy Concealer for a smooth, bright finish, then set with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: How do I apply it without pulling the under-eye skin?
faqs.answer: Warm the tip on the back of your hand, then place it on the skin with light pressure and let the product glide. Blend by pressing with your ring finger or the Concealer Brush instead of rubbing back and forth.

faqs.question: Is it fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Simply Apricot is clean beauty, fragrance-free and cruelty-free, with a creamy, moisturizing shea butter formula. It is made in the USA.

faqs.question: Where does it go in my routine?
faqs.answer: After moisturizer and sunscreen have absorbed, apply Simply Apricot to the discoloration, then Creamy Concealer over it, then your BB Crème or foundation. Finish by setting the under-eye area lightly with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: Where can I see how to apply it?
faqs.answer: Nikol walks through Simply Apricot on her YouTube channel, youtube.com/nikoljohnson, showing placement, blending and how to layer concealer over it. If you have a question about your own under-eye concern, email hello@nikolbeauty.com and we will help.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Color Corrector Collection and which corrector to reach for.

faqs.question: Which three correctors come in the collection?
faqs.answer: The Color Corrector Collection includes Just Peachy, No Redness and Simply Apricot, our newly reformulated correctors with a creamy, moisturizing shea butter formula. Together they cover redness, darkness, and blue and purple discoloration.

faqs.question: Which one do I use for dark circles, and which for redness?
faqs.answer: Use No Redness (green) on redness, rosacea and blemishes anywhere on the face. Use Just Peachy on dark under-eye circles if you are fair to light-medium, or Simply Apricot if you are light-medium to medium or your circles lean blue or purple.

faqs.question: Is the collection suitable for my skin tone?
faqs.answer: No Redness works on all skin tones. Just Peachy is designed for fair to light-medium skin and Simply Apricot for light-medium to medium skin, so between the two you are covered from fair through medium complexions. Email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo if you would like help deciding which corrector to reach for.

faqs.question: How much do I save buying all three together?
faqs.answer: You save 15 percent compared with buying the three correctors individually. Only one discount code can be applied per order, and the bundle price is already reduced.

faqs.question: Can I use more than one corrector at a time?
faqs.answer: Yes, but place each one only where it is needed rather than layering them on the same spot. For example, No Redness on the cheeks and nose and Just Peachy under the eyes, each blended thinly before your concealer and BB Crème go on top.

faqs.question: What order do they go in with concealer, BB Crème and powder?
faqs.answer: Moisturizer first, then the corrector on the area of concern, then Creamy Concealer where you want extra coverage, then BB Crème or Serum Foundation over the face. Finish by setting with Nikita Banana Brightening Powder.

faqs.question: Are the correctors fragrance-free?
faqs.answer: Yes. All three are clean beauty, fragrance-free and cruelty-free, and they are made in the USA. The lightweight, creamy texture is comfortable on sensitive and mature skin.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about our Eye Primer and crease-free eyeshadow.

faqs.question: Is the Eye Primer tinted, and will the color show on my lids?
faqs.answer: Yes, it has a soft skin tone that neutralizes the natural darkness of the eyelid so your eyeshadow reads its true color. Applied in a thin layer and blended to the edges, it disappears into the skin and simply looks like an even, brighter lid.

faqs.question: It looks a little dark or yellow on me. Am I using too much?
faqs.answer: Most likely, yes. A small dot is enough for both lids. Blend it thin with the Concealer Brush or your fingertip all the way to the brow bone, then give it 30 to 60 seconds to set before applying shadow. Once eyeshadow goes over it, the tone of the primer is no longer visible.

faqs.question: How thin a layer should I apply, and do I let it set first?
faqs.answer: Apply a very thin, even layer from lash line to brow bone and let it set for about a minute until it feels smooth rather than tacky. That set layer is what keeps shadow from creasing all day.

faqs.question: Will it stop shadow creasing on hooded or crepey lids?
faqs.answer: That is what it was made for. As eyelid skin thins and loses elasticity, shadow tends to crease and fade into fine lines. Eye Primer creates a smooth, even canvas that holds eyeshadow in place from morning to night, even on oily lids and during hot flashes.

faqs.question: Does it work under both powder and cream shadows?
faqs.answer: Yes. It gives powder shadows something to grip so they look more pigmented, and it keeps cream shadows and liners from sliding. Let it set fully before applying either.

faqs.question: Can I wear it on its own as a lid concealer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many customers wear a thin layer alone on no-makeup days to even out lid discoloration and give a fresh, awake look.

faqs.question: Will it make my eyeshadow colors look brighter?
faqs.answer: Yes. By neutralizing the darkness of the lid, Eye Primer lets shadows show their true color instead of looking muddy, so your palettes look more vibrant and stay true all day.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers?
faqs.answer: Eye Primer is formulated without fragrance or parabens and is gentle enough for sensitive eyes. It is applied to the lid only, away from the lash line and waterline, so it is comfortable for contact lens wearers. It is cruelty-free.

faqs.question: How long does one tube last?
faqs.answer: Because you need only a small dot for both eyes, one tube lasts for months of daily use. Keep the cap closed tightly and store it at room temperature.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Volume Up Mascara, from choosing a color to removal.

faqs.question: Is Volume Up Mascara waterproof or water-resistant?

faqs.question: Which color should I choose: Jet Black #27 or Dark Brown #72?
faqs.answer: Jet Black gives the most definition and is lovely for evening or for darker hair and brows. Dark Brown is softer and very flattering on blonde, grey and silver hair, and many customers use it on the lower lashes for a natural daytime look. Our Volume Up Mascara Bundle includes both.

faqs.question: What do I do if the wand picks up too much product?

faqs.question: How should I store it so it stays fresh?
faqs.answer: Close the tube tightly after each use and avoid pumping the wand in and out, which pushes air into the tube and dries the formula. Store it at room temperature away from heat, and replace your mascara every three months for eye hygiene.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Volume Up Mascara is safe for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers. The creamy, nourishing formula contains Candelilla dispersed in Jojoba oil for adhesion and antioxidant Vitamin E, and it is cruelty-free and made in Italy.

faqs.question: Will it flake or transfer under my eyes during the day?
faqs.answer: The formula is transfer-resistant, so it is designed to stay on the lashes. Let each coat set for a few seconds before adding another, keep the lower lashes to a light coat, and avoid applying heavy eye cream right before mascara, which can cause any mascara to move.

faqs.question: How do I use the wand on short, sparse lashes?
faqs.answer: The wand has tiny teeth all the way around, made to grip and lift every little lash. Place the wand at the root, wiggle side to side, then sweep up. Use the tip of the wand vertically to reach the small inner and outer lashes and the lower lashes. Nikol shows more wand techniques on her YouTube channel.

faqs.question: What is the best way to remove it at night?
faqs.answer: Because it is water-resistant rather than waterproof, it comes off easily. Hold a cotton pad soaked in warm water or your gentle eye makeup remover against closed lashes for a few seconds, then wipe downward without rubbing.

faqs.question: How long should a tube last before I replace it?

faqs.question: Which shade suits my eye color and skin tone?

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Cream Blush Stick, from choosing a shade to blending.

faqs.question: Which Cream Blush Stick shade suits me?

faqs.question: Do I apply it with fingers, a brush or a sponge?

faqs.question: Will it sit in lines or drag on mature skin?

faqs.question: Is it suitable for oily or dry skin?
faqs.answer: Yes to both. Dry skin loves the creamy, non-drying texture. If your skin is oily, apply a thin layer and set lightly with powder to keep the glow in place all day.

faqs.question: How long does the color last on the skin?

faqs.question: How thick a layer should I apply before bed?
faqs.answer: A thin, even layer is all you need; the silk melt-in texture is designed for comfort, not mess. Apply with a clean fingertip or a lip brush and let it settle before you lie down.

faqs.question: Will it transfer onto my pillow?
faqs.answer: The non-sticky formula melts into the lips rather than sitting on top, so with a thin layer transfer is minimal. Give it a minute to absorb before bed.

faqs.question: Does it help the fine lines around my lips?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dream Melt was created for mature lips and helps smooth the look of fine lines around the mouth by deeply hydrating overnight, so lips look smoother and feel softer by morning, ready for lipstick.

faqs.question: Is it fragrance-free and vegan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dream Melt Lip Mask is fragrance-free, vegan and cruelty-free, made in Italy with clean, skin-loving ingredients.

faqs.question: What should I do if the jar arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a clear photo of the damage and the invoice from your package. Our Customer Care team will review it and follow up to make it right.

faqs.question: How should I store it?
faqs.answer: Keep the lid closed tightly and store it at room temperature away from heat and direct sun. Use a clean fingertip or lip brush each time to keep the formula fresh.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Nikol Beauty Lipstick Case.

faqs.question: How many lipsticks does the case hold?
faqs.answer: The Nikol Beauty Lipstick Case fits two Nikol Beauty lipsticks. You can also use it for tissues, Eye Primer or a Cream Blush Stick when you are traveling light. Lipsticks are sold separately.

faqs.question: Does it have a mirror?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a mirror built into the top of the case so you can touch up your lipstick anywhere without hunting for a compact.

faqs.question: What is it made of, and how big is it?
faqs.answer: The case is made of 100 percent vegan material in a sophisticated metallic silver with a silver zipper and the Nikol Beauty logo embossed on top. It measures 3.9 by 2.7 by 1.38 inches and arrives in a beautiful gift box.

faqs.question: Will it protect my lipsticks in a handbag?
faqs.answer: Yes. The zippered case keeps your lipsticks together, clean and easy to find, so you always know you have the right color for day or evening. As with any lipstick, avoid leaving your bag in a hot car.

faqs.question: Is it a good gift?
faqs.answer: It is one of our favorite gifts. The case comes in a gift box, and pairing it with two Shiny Velvet Cream Lipsticks makes a complete present. A Nikol Beauty Gift Card is a lovely option if you would rather let her choose the shades.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Essential Makeup Brush Set, from what each brush does to washing.

faqs.question: Which brush in the set is for what?
faqs.answer: Every brush is named on the handle, so you always know which one to reach for. The set of ten was hand-picked by Nikol for her clients: brushes for foundation and powder, concealer, blush and bronzer, and several for eyeshadow and brows, each chosen for durability and the specific job it does.

faqs.question: How many brushes are included, and what is the case like?
faqs.answer: The kit includes ten brushes in a beautiful blush pink protective tube. The top of the tube doubles as a holder for your daily cosmetics, from mascara to brow pencils, so everything stays within reach on your vanity or in your suitcase.

faqs.question: Is the set practical to travel with?
faqs.answer: Yes, it was designed as a travel set. The brushes are compact and the protective tube keeps them clean and undamaged in a suitcase or tote, and the whole set is light enough for everyday carry.

faqs.question: Are the bristles vegan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Essential Makeup Brush Set is 100 percent vegan and cruelty-free, with soft synthetic bristles that work with both cream and powder products.

faqs.question: How do I wash them, and how often?
faqs.answer: Wash complexion brushes weekly and eye brushes every one to two weeks with our Lux Brush Soap. Wet the bristles with the brush pointing down, swirl on the soap, rinse until clear, reshape and lay flat to dry. Keep water out of the ferrule, the metal neck, to protect the glue.

faqs.question: Do they work with cream products as well as powder?
faqs.answer: Yes. Synthetic bristles do not absorb cream products, so the set works beautifully with BB Crème, Cream Blush Stick and Creamy Concealer as well as our powders and eyeshadows.

faqs.question: What should I do if a brush arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a clear photo and the invoice from your package, and our Customer Care team will make it right. Washing with the brush pointing down and drying flat keeps the handles and ferrules secure for years.

faqs.question: Do I need any other brushes on top of this set?
faqs.answer: The set covers a complete face. Popular additions are the Soft Set Technique Brush for setting under the eyes with Nikita Banana powder, the Foundation Buffing Brush for a buffed base, and the Concealer Brush for precise under-eye work.

faqs.question: Are they designed for mature-skin application?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nikol selected each of the ten not-so-basic brushes for the way mature skin needs product placed and blended: soft enough for thinner skin, dense enough to press product in rather than drag it.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Foundation Buffing Brush.

faqs.question: How do I use the Foundation Buffing Brush without streaks?
faqs.answer: Dot your BB Crème, Serum Foundation or tinted moisturizer onto the face, then buff in small circular motions, working from the center of the face outward. Finish with light pressing motions over the cheeks to melt the product in. A little product and a light hand give the smoothest result.

faqs.question: Does it work with the Serum Foundation dropper and the BB Crème?
faqs.answer: Yes, it pairs perfectly with both. Dispense Serum Foundation onto the back of your hand and pick it up with the brush, or apply a pump of BB Crème to the face and buff.

faqs.question: Will it give more or less coverage than my fingers?
faqs.answer: A buffing brush gives a more even, airbrushed finish and lets you build coverage in thin layers, while fingers tend to sheer product out. Use the brush for the base and your fingertips to press in any spots that need extra blending.

faqs.question: Are the bristles vegan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Foundation Buffing Brush is 100 percent vegan and cruelty-free with soft synthetic bristles.

faqs.question: How do I wash and dry it?
faqs.answer: Wash weekly with Lux Brush Soap: wet the bristles with the brush pointing down, swirl on the soap, rinse until the water runs clear, squeeze gently, reshape and lay flat to dry. Keep water out of the ferrule, the metal neck, to protect the glue.

faqs.question: Is it too big for the under-eye area?
faqs.answer: It is designed for the face. For the under-eye area use the Concealer Brush, which has a dense, sculpted tip for precise placement of Creamy Concealer and Eye Brightener.

faqs.question: Can I use it with powder as well?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once clean and dry it buffs Nikita Banana Brightening Powder or Crème Brûlée bronzer into the skin beautifully. Keep one brush for cream and one for powder if you use both daily.

faqs.question: How long should it last?
faqs.answer: With weekly washing and flat drying, a quality synthetic brush lasts for years. If your brush arrives damaged, email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a photo and your invoice and we will make it right.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Concealer Brush.

faqs.question: How do I use the Concealer Brush under my eyes?
faqs.answer: Dot Creamy Concealer onto the darkest area, then use the dense, sculpted tip to press and blend outward in small patting motions. The shape follows the curve under the eye so you can place product precisely without dragging the skin.

faqs.question: Are the bristles soft enough for delicate under-eye skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. The brush was redesigned for comfort and ease of application, with uniquely sculpted bristles that are soft on the skin yet dense enough to blend concealer seamlessly.

faqs.question: Which products does it work with?
faqs.answer: It works with all formulas and is perfect for Eye Primer, Creamy Concealer and Eye Brightener. It also blends Just Peachy, Simply Apricot and No Redness color correctors precisely where you need them.

faqs.question: How do I wash it?
faqs.answer: Wash weekly with Lux Brush Soap: wet the bristles with the brush pointing down, swirl on the soap, rinse until clear, reshape and lay flat to dry. Keep water out of the ferrule, the metal neck, to protect the glue.

faqs.question: How does it compare with using my fingers?
faqs.answer: Fingers warm the product and are wonderful for a final press, but the brush places concealer exactly where you want it and builds coverage in thin layers without pulling the skin. Many customers use the brush to apply and a ring finger to finish.

faqs.question: Is it vegan and cruelty-free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Concealer Brush is vegan and cruelty-free, and it fits seamlessly into the Essential Makeup Brush Set.

faqs.question: How long is the handle?
faqs.answer: The handle is approximately 4 inches long, sized for control and for slipping into a makeup bag. Brush coverage is buildable.

faqs.question: What should I do if the brush arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a clear photo and the invoice from your package, and our Customer Care team will make it right.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Eyeshadow Blending Brush.

faqs.question: Is this brush for blending or for packing shadow onto the lid?
faqs.answer: The Eyeshadow Blending Brush is for blending. Use it in small circular motions through the crease to soften edges and diffuse color. To pack color onto the lid, use the flat shadow brushes from the Essential Makeup Brush Set or the brushes included in our pearlized palettes.

faqs.question: Do I need a second brush to apply color?
faqs.answer: For the cleanest result, yes: one brush to place color and this one to blend. If you keep only one, the Blending Brush can also apply a soft wash of a single shade across the lid.

faqs.question: Is it soft enough for thin eyelid skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. The soft, fluffy bristles are made to blend with light pressure, which is exactly what mature eyelids need. Let the brush do the work and avoid pressing hard.

faqs.question: How do I wash it?
faqs.answer: Wash every one to two weeks with Lux Brush Soap: wet the bristles with the brush pointing down, swirl on the soap, rinse until clear, reshape and lay flat to dry. Keep water out of the ferrule, the metal neck.

faqs.question: Is it vegan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Like all Nikol Beauty brushes it is vegan and cruelty-free with soft synthetic bristles.

faqs.question: Which palettes does it work best with?
faqs.answer: All of them. It is especially useful with the matte palettes, Rewrite The Rules and Strong Brew, for diffusing the deepest shade through the crease, and for softening the edges of the pearlized palettes such as The Cabana.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Concealer/Lip Brush.

faqs.question: Is this brush for lipstick or for concealer?
faqs.answer: Both. It is a dual-ended brush with a precision concealer brush on one end and a lip brush on the other, so you can apply Creamy Concealer like a pro and then line and fill your lips with lipstick for a perfect edge.

faqs.question: Is it firm enough to blend concealer under the eyes?
faqs.answer: Yes. The concealer end is soft on the under-eye area yet precise, ideal for placing and patting Creamy Concealer, Eye Brightener or a color corrector exactly where you need it.

faqs.question: How do I clean it?
faqs.answer: Wash weekly with Lux Brush Soap: wet each end with the bristles pointing down, swirl on the soap, rinse until clear, reshape and lay flat to dry. Keep water out of the ferrule, the metal neck.

faqs.question: Is it vegan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Concealer/Lip Brush is 100 percent vegan and cruelty-free, and it is perfect to carry in your makeup bag.

faqs.question: How does it differ from the Concealer Brush?
faqs.answer: The Concealer Brush is a single-ended brush with a denser, sculpted tip for buildable coverage. The Concealer/Lip Brush is dual-ended and more compact, giving you a precision concealer brush and a lip brush in one travel-friendly tool. It is available for a limited time.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Soft Set Technique Brush.

faqs.question: What is the Soft Set technique, and how do I use this brush?
faqs.answer: Soft Set is Nikol’s method for setting the under-eye without heaviness. Press the angled side of the brush into Nikita Banana Brightening Powder, then gently press it into the under-eye area as a finishing step. The dense, tapered tip places just the right amount of powder for a skin-like finish.

faqs.question: Is it only for setting under the eyes?
faqs.answer: That is its specialty, but it is also perfect for setting Nikita Banana over creamy concealer, color correctors or Eye Brightener anywhere you want precise, controlled powder placement, such as around the nose and mouth.

faqs.question: How much powder should it pick up?
faqs.answer: Very little. Press the angled side into the powder once and tap off any excess. The brush is designed to deliver the ideal amount for mature skin, so one light press per eye is usually enough.

faqs.question: Does it fit with the Essential Makeup Brush Set?
faqs.answer: Yes. It was designed as an add-on to the Essential Makeup Brush Set and fits seamlessly into the set’s protective tube. The handle is approximately 4 inches long.

faqs.question: Is it soft enough for under-eye skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. The uniquely sculpted vegan bristles are soft on delicate skin while the dense, tapered tip gives you controlled, precise placement. It is cruelty-free.

faqs.question: How do I wash it?
faqs.answer: Wash weekly with Lux Brush Soap: wet the bristles with the brush pointing down, swirl on the soap, rinse until clear, reshape and lay flat to dry. Keep water out of the ferrule, the metal neck, to protect the glue.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Lux Brush Soap and caring for your brushes.

faqs.question: Should I buy the large size or the travel size?
faqs.answer: Choose the large Lux Brush Soap for your vanity if you wash brushes weekly; it lasts for months. The travel size is perfect for trips or for keeping in your makeup bag so you can clean brushes on the go. Both come in a tin with the built-in silicone scrubber.

faqs.question: How do I use it without getting water into the ferrule?
faqs.answer: Wet the brush under running water with the bristles pointing down and keep it angled downward the whole time so water runs away from the ferrule, the silver metal neck. Swirl the damp bristles on the soap and the silicone scrubber, rinse until the water runs clear, squeeze gently, reshape and lay flat to dry.

faqs.question: How often should I wash my brushes?
faqs.answer: Wash complexion brushes used with BB Crème, concealer and cream blush about once a week, and eyeshadow and powder brushes every one to two weeks. Regular cleaning keeps bristles soft, colors true and skin happy.

faqs.question: Does the tin come with the silicone scrubber?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each tin has a built-in silicone scrubber pad designed to make cleaning easier and more efficient, so you do not need a separate cleaning mat.

faqs.question: Will it dry out or damage synthetic bristles?
faqs.answer: No. Lux Brush Soap is an all-natural, vegan formula made in Italy with high-quality coconut oil that deeply cleanses while conditioning and nourishing the bristles, helping them stay soft and last longer. It is safe for our vegan synthetic brushes.

faqs.question: Will it remove stubborn makeup like cream blush and concealer?
faqs.answer: Yes. The professional-grade coconut-oil formula is known for removing even the most stubborn makeup residue. For heavily used brushes, swirl on the soap, work the bristles across the scrubber, rinse and repeat once.

faqs.question: How long does one tin last?
faqs.answer: A little soap goes a long way, so the large tin lasts many months of weekly washing and the travel tin is ideal for several trips. Let the soap dry with the lid off before closing the tin to keep it fresh.

faqs.question: Can I use it on sponges too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wet the sponge, work the soap through it on the scrubber, rinse until the water runs clear and squeeze out the excess. Let it dry fully in an open space before storing.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Pencil Sharpener and our rounded-tip pencils.

faqs.question: Why do the pencils not sharpen to a fine point?
faqs.answer: That is by design. Nikol Beauty eyeliner and lip liner pencils are a softer, creamier formula made for mature skin, and they sharpen to a soft, rounded end rather than a sharp point. The rounded tip glides without tugging and gives a flattering, slightly diffused line. Trying to force a point can damage the barrel and the formula.

faqs.question: How many twists does it take to sharpen properly?
faqs.answer: One or two gentle twists is all you need. Sharpening more than that only removes product; the rounded end is the finished shape.

faqs.question: What if the pencil seems to crumble while sharpening?
faqs.answer: A creamy pencil can soften in a warm room or bag. Place the pencil in the refrigerator for ten minutes to firm the core, then sharpen with one or two light twists without pressing the pencil into the blade. Emptying the shavings and keeping the blade clean also helps it cut smoothly.

faqs.question: Will it fit both the eyeliner and the lip liner pencils?
faqs.answer: Yes. The sharpener was custom-designed to work with Nikol Beauty eyeliners and lip liners, including the Crystal Clear Invisible Lip Liner, and shapes each to the intended rounded end.

faqs.question: How do I clean the blade and empty the shavings?
faqs.answer: The sharpener has a cover that captures shavings and a built-in blade cleaner. Open the cover to tip out the shavings, then use the cleaner to clear any product from the blade so it stays sharp and clean.

faqs.question: Can I use a different sharpener on your pencils?
faqs.answer: We recommend ours. Standard sharpeners are made for firmer pencils and often grab too much of our creamy core, wasting product and roughening the tip. Our sharpener, made in Germany, was designed for the diameter and softness of Nikol Beauty pencils.

faqs.question: Does it work on the Skinny Brow Pencil?
faqs.answer: The Skinny Brow Pencil does not need sharpening; it is a fine-tip twist-up pencil. The sharpener is for our Waterproof Eyeliner Pencils, Waterproof Lip Liner Pencils and Crystal Clear Invisible Lip Liner.

faqs.question: What should I do if the sharpener arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a clear photo and the invoice from your package, and our Customer Care team will make it right.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Stainless Steel Gua Sha.

faqs.question: How do I use the Gua Sha, and are fuller instructions available?
faqs.answer: Apply a facial oil or serum so the tool glides, hold the Gua Sha almost flat against the skin and sweep gently from the center of the face outward and upward, three to five strokes per area. Nikol demonstrates her full routine on her YouTube channel, youtube.com/nikoljohnson.

faqs.question: Which direction do I work in on the face and neck?
faqs.answer: Always outward and upward: from the center of the chin along the jaw toward the ear, from the nose across the cheek toward the temple, and from the brow up toward the hairline. On the neck, sweep gently downward toward the collarbone to encourage lymphatic drainage.

faqs.question: Do I need to use oil or serum with it?
faqs.answer: Yes. A few drops of facial oil or a hydrating serum let the stainless steel glide without pulling the skin. Never use the tool on dry skin.

faqs.question: How often should I use it?
faqs.answer: A few minutes each morning or evening is ideal, and even two or three times a week helps release tension, support circulation and enhance the appearance of the skin. Use light pressure; more is not better.

faqs.question: Why stainless steel instead of stone?
faqs.answer: Stainless steel stays naturally cool, is non-porous and easy to keep hygienic, and will not chip or crack if dropped. Ours comes with a custom blush pink vegan leather holder to protect it on your vanity, in your gym bag or in your luggage.

faqs.question: How do I clean it?
faqs.answer: Wash with warm water and a gentle soap after each use, dry thoroughly and return it to its holder. For a cooling treat, keep it in the refrigerator between uses.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Cooling Eye Roller.

faqs.question: How do I use the Cooling Eye Roller?
faqs.answer: Apply your favorite eye cream or serum, then glide the roller gently from the inner corner of the under-eye outward toward the temple, repeating a few times. The cool tip massages the product in while instantly helping to de-puff the under-eye area.

faqs.question: Do I need to keep it in the fridge to get the cooling effect?
faqs.answer: The metal tip feels cool on its own, but keeping the roller in the refrigerator gives an extra cooling boost that many customers love, especially on puffy mornings.

faqs.question: How long should I use it for in the morning?
faqs.answer: About one minute per eye is plenty. Use light pressure and slow, outward strokes; the goal is a gentle massage, not firm pressure on the delicate eye area.

faqs.question: Does it help with puffiness or with dark circles?
faqs.answer: It is designed for puffiness and tired-looking eyes: the cooling massage helps the under-eye look refreshed and revitalized. For dark circles, follow with Just Peachy or Simply Apricot color corrector and Creamy Concealer.

faqs.question: Can I use it with any eye cream or serum?
faqs.answer: Yes. It works with any of your go-to eye creams or serums, morning or night, and helps them absorb evenly while adding a spa-like moment to your routine.

faqs.question: How do I clean it?
faqs.answer: Wipe the roller tip with a damp cloth or a little gentle soap and water after each use, dry it and store it in a clean, dry place or the refrigerator. If it arrives damaged, email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with a photo and your invoice and we will make it right.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the 10x Magnification Mirror.

faqs.question: Is 10x magnification too strong for everyday makeup?
faqs.answer: 10x is the magnification professionals use for detail work. It is ideal for eyeliner, brow shaping, applying mascara to every lash and blending concealer, and it reveals fine lines and texture so you can place product exactly where you want it. Use it for the close work, then step back to a regular mirror to check the overall look.

faqs.question: What does the LED ring light do?
faqs.answer: The built-in LED ring light surrounds the mirror to eliminate shadows and provide true-to-life illumination. Even lighting makes it far easier to match foundation shades, blend edges and see whether your brows are symmetrical.

faqs.question: Who is this mirror designed for?
faqs.answer: It was designed for mature skin that deserves a closer look. Compact and elegant, it brings professional-grade clarity to eyeshadow application, brow shaping and flawless foundation blending at home.

faqs.question: How do I clean the mirror?
faqs.answer: Wipe the glass with a soft, dry microfiber cloth. For smudges, lightly dampen the cloth with water and dry immediately. Avoid spraying liquid directly onto the mirror to protect the LED light.

faqs.question: What should I do if the light does not work properly?
faqs.answer: Email hello@nikolbeauty.com within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a short video showing the issue. Our Customer Care team will review it and arrange a replacement, including a prepaid label to return the defective mirror.

faqs.question: Is it a good gift?
faqs.answer: It is one of our most-loved gifts for the makeup lover who wants to see every detail. Pair it with the Essential Makeup Brush Set or a Nikol Beauty Gift Card for a complete present.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the No-Crease Hair Clips.

faqs.question: What are the No-Crease Hair Clips for?
faqs.answer: They keep every strand out of your face while you do your skincare and makeup, so you can apply your Nikol Beauty look without hair in the way and without a dent left behind when you take them out.

faqs.question: Will they hold my hair without creasing it?
faqs.answer: Yes. The clips are designed to be creaseless, gripping the hair firmly enough to hold sections back during glam time and releasing without a mark, so your blowout stays intact.

faqs.question: How do I use them?
faqs.answer: Section your hair away from your face, slide a clip in flat against the head and close it. Use one on each side for a fringe or front layers, or gather everything back with two or three clips for a full skincare routine.

faqs.question: Are they a limited-edition item?
faqs.answer: Yes. The No-Crease Hair Clips are limited edition. If they show as sold out, click Notify Me When Back In Stock on the product page and you will receive an email as soon as inventory returns.

pages.page_name: These Bags Are Designer Eye Mask
pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about our reusable silicone eye masks.

faqs.question: How do I use the eye masks? Do I put serum on first?
faqs.answer: Yes. Apply your eye cream or serum to the under-eye area, then place a mask over each eye and smooth it down. The 100 percent medical-grade silicone holds the product close to the skin so it fully absorbs rather than evaporating.

faqs.question: How long should I leave them on?
faqs.answer: Ten to twenty minutes is ideal, or while you do the rest of your skincare and makeup. They are lightweight and thin enough to wear daily.

faqs.question: How many times can I reuse them?
faqs.answer: They are designed to be reused again and again. Rinse them after each use and store them in the tin, and with care they last for months of daily use.

faqs.question: Do they stay in place while I move around?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applied to skin with a thin layer of serum or cream, the silicone clings gently and stays put while you move through your routine. If they slip, use a little less product underneath.

faqs.question: How do I clean them between uses?
faqs.answer: After each use, run the masks under cold water to remove any skincare residue, dry them flat and place them back in the reusable tin so they stay clean and ready.

faqs.question: Can I wear them while doing my eye makeup?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. They are ideal for catching eyeshadow fallout: place them under the eyes while you blend, then remove them and apply your concealer to a perfectly clean under-eye.

faqs.question: What are they made from, and are they suitable for my skin type?
faqs.answer: They are made from 100 percent medical-grade silicone for safety and durability, and they suit normal, dry, combination and oily skin. They come packaged in a reusable tin embossed with our rose.

faqs.question: Do they help with puffiness, dark circles or both?
faqs.answer: The masks help whichever product you use underneath work harder by locking it against the skin, so pair them with a de-puffing gel for puffiness or a brightening eye cream for dark circles. For an instant cooling boost, use them with the Cooling Eye Roller first.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about The Best Seller Beauty Bundle, from what is inside to choosing shades.

faqs.question: Exactly which products are in The Best Seller Beauty Bundle?
faqs.answer: You receive ten of our best sellers: Eye Primer, BB Crème, NikRay Shiny Velvet Cream Lipstick, Rose Lip Balm, Waterproof Lip Liner in Cameo, Cream Blush Stick, Volume Up Mascara, the Essential Makeup Brush Set, Skinny Brow Pencil and our Precision Eyebrow Stencils. Everything you need for a polished, natural look.

faqs.question: Which shades do I need to choose?
faqs.answer: You choose three shades on the product page: your Cream Blush Stick color (Palm Beach, St. Barths, Paris or Coconut Row Bronzer), your BB Crème shade (Fair, Light, Light/Medium or Tan) and your Skinny Brow Pencil shade (Dark Blonde, Taupe, Brownie or Soft Gray). Email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo if you would like help choosing.

faqs.question: How much do I save compared with buying separately?
faqs.answer: The bundle saves you 15 percent compared with buying the ten products individually. The savings is already built into the bundle price; only one discount code can be applied per order.

faqs.question: Are these the same products sold individually?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each item in the bundle is the same product you would buy on its own page, simply packaged together at a savings.

faqs.question: What if one of the shades I picked does not suit me?
faqs.answer: Because our products are personal-care items, all sales are final and we cannot accept returns or exchanges once an order has shipped. We are glad to help before you order: email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo and we will recommend your shades. If any item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and your invoice and we will make it right.

faqs.question: Can I swap an item for something else?
faqs.answer: The bundle is a fixed set, so items cannot be swapped, but you can add any other product to your order. Orders of 125 dollars or more ship free within the US.

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Beginner Beauty Bundle, from what is inside to choosing shades.

faqs.question: What is included in the Beginner Beauty Bundle, and is it enough for a complete look?
faqs.answer: The box includes Eye Primer, Volume Up Mascara, Brow Mascara, Rose Lip Balm, Skinny Brow Pencil, our Precision Eyebrow Stencils and Creamy Concealer. Nikol curated it as just the necessities for a fresh, minimalistic look: brightened eyes, defined brows, soft lips and a concealed under-eye.

faqs.question: Which shades do I choose?
faqs.answer: You choose three shades on the product page: Volume Up Mascara in Jet Black or Dark Brown, Creamy Concealer in Fair, Light or Med, and Skinny Brow Pencil in Dark Blonde, Taupe, Brownie or Soft Gray. Email hello@nikolbeauty.com with a natural-light photo if you would like help choosing.

faqs.question: Is it suitable if I have never worn much makeup?

faqs.question: What order do I apply them in?

pages.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Volume Up Mascara Bundle.

faqs.question: Which two colors come in the Volume Up Mascara Bundle?
faqs.answer: You receive both Volume Up Mascara shades: #27 Jet Black and #72 Dark Brown. Wear Dark Brown for a softer daytime look or on the lower lashes, and Jet Black when you want a darker, more defined lash.

faqs.question: Is the formula the same as the single mascara?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is the same creamy, nourishing Volume Up formula with Candelilla dispersed in Jojoba oil for adhesion, antioxidant Vitamin E and a glossy finish, with the same customized wand whose tiny teeth grip and lift every lash. Each tube holds 11 ml and is made in Italy.

faqs.question: Is it water-resistant or waterproof?
faqs.answer: Volume Up is water-resistant and transfer-resistant, not waterproof. It holds up to everyday wear and watery eyes yet removes easily at night with warm water or a gentle eye makeup remover.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Volume Up Mascara is safe for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers, and it is cruelty-free.

faqs.question: How long will two tubes stay fresh once opened?
faqs.answer: For eye hygiene we recommend replacing any mascara about three months after opening. Keep the second tube sealed until you need it, and store both at room temperature with the caps closed tightly.

faqs.question: Do I save by buying the bundle?
